description: warren K8s dogfood dispatch (pi + kimi-k3, plan-run pl-2dbb child 1): run hung after agent settled — stdin-hold watchdog killed pi without a terminal envelope, reap never triggered, pod polled finalize-intent forever, run row stuck running. Salvage captured nothing (no git credential in window; agent had not committed). Manual recovery: kubectl exec into live pod, git add/commit with pod's GIT_AUTHOR_* env, git bundle main..HEAD, kubectl cp out, fetch bundle into local repo, push branch, hand-open PR. Root cause + fix sketch recorded in warren-9a4a; salvage gaps in warren-6016.
resolution: Until warren-9a4a ships: do not dispatch stdin-held (pi) agents to the K8s instance for unattended runs; claude-code batch agent is immune (emits result envelope). If a run hangs at settle: salvage via kubectl exec commit + bundle BEFORE cancelling (cancel deletes the pod and the emptyDir).

description: Plan-run seeds conflicts are structural, not incidental: closing any plan child rewrites updatedAt+blockedBy on the parent and all siblings, so every pair of consecutive sibling PRs conflicts on .seeds/issues.jsonl. The seeds-jsonl driver set-merges blockedBy fine but fails on both-changed updatedAt scalars. Manual fix that works: normalize updatedAt to max(ours,theirs) on the conflicted rows in both stage files, re-run 'bun scripts/merge-seeds-jsonl.ts anc ours theirs', verify check:seeds-integrity + no dup ids, push. Filed warren-d8f0 to make the driver do this itself.
resolution: Normalize both-changed updatedAt to max then re-run driver; filed warren-d8f0 for the permanent fix

name: extension-deps-ci-install
description: First extension with a real npm dependency (@warren-ext/judge -> @sinclair/typebox) broke root bun test in CI: the root sweep discovers extensions/*/src/*.test.ts but CI only ran root bun install, so extension node_modules never existed (audit-log masked this with zero deps). Fix pattern mirrors ui:install: root script ext:install = 'for d in extensions/*/; do (cd $d && bun install); done' + a CI step before the test sweep, and the same step in release.yml. A warren repair run (ref=targetBranch=PR head branch) shipped it for $0.30.

description: good-first-issue batch 2026-08-18: warren-a553 (transient provider_error auto-retry) was born dead — PR #935/191c0ef1 (warren-339d) shipped the exact run-level retry ~19.5h before the row was filed, because the author observed a live instance running an older deploy. Second confirmed instance of the born-dead pattern (#808 was the first).
resolution: Verification against HEAD before filing caught it: closed warren-a553 citing 191c0ef1, split the live residual (retry classifier ignores structured httpStatus from warren-4001 enrichment) into warren-f8b2 and filed it as GitHub #975. Rows filed from live-instance observations need a deployed-version-vs-HEAD check on top of the standard born-dead git-log check.

title: v0.18.0 any-setup campaign charter (pl-a37b)
rationale: Owner decisions 2026-08-18: core dispatch_context table over extension store (event-stream reconstruction is permanently lossy for override-source, queue-state, and retry-lineage facts); contract + RemoteTracker bridge in one release so 0.18 ships the full bring-your-own-tracker story minus Linear; all four external-readiness features because the release's purpose is foreign-repo readiness; NetworkPolicy scoped because eviction drills need an operator, not an agent.

content: Before consolidating multi-agent review findings into a posted review, read the linked issue (gh issue view / sd show) and the PR body. Downgrade two classes of findings: (1) anything the issue explicitly scoped out or prescribed (e.g. issue #973 prescribed the exact PRAGMA+ALTER migration guard the review then flagged, and scoped out backfill) becomes a follow-up-issue candidate, not a blocker; (2) anything the author already disclosed in the PR body (e.g. PR #981's 'One thing I did not do' section offering to generalize commandFailure) is a scoping question for the maintainer, not a discovered defect. Only findings inside the issue's stated scope justify request-changes.

description: Dogfood dispatch referenced seedId warren-968d that existed only in the local .seeds (unpushed): the warren run clone lacked the row, so the agent silently created duplicate warren-7278 and the real seed stayed open on origin until manual reconciliation (close + dup annotation).
resolution: Always push .seeds to origin BEFORE dispatching any run that passes seedId; verify with git show origin/main:.seeds/issues.jsonl. Product fix filed as warren-8fd5 (dispatch-time seedId validation).

name: seeds-pr-driver-merge-shepherding
description: PR shepherding for parallel warren run PRs that all touch .seeds/issues.jsonl: when a PR goes DIRTY, do the driver-aware merge manually without waiting for seeds-merge-autoheal — git worktree add on the PR branch, git merge origin/main --no-edit (seeds-jsonl driver registered by bun install), check:seeds-integrity + uniq -d on ids, push, then gh pr merge --auto --squash. Worked cleanly for PRs #1095/#1096 (2026-08-27); a BEHIND PR with auto-merge armed merged without another update.

Campaign-controller live dry run (camp-openclaw-129750) surfaced warren-5255: the dispatcher settled resultBranch from run.targetBranch, which is the operator override and null on every default dispatch — the composed prefix/runId branch was never persisted or served on the run wire, so pr_intent refused run_branch_missing.
resolution: Core: spawnRun persists the composed branch (RunsRepo.setBranch inside the dispatch rollback boundary) and serves it as a public run wire field (PR #1111). Extension: dispatcher reads run.branch with targetBranch fallback; pr_intent backfills a null journaled branch via safe GET /runs/:id before rendering.

title: Phase 2 go-live: first live cross-fork PR on openclaw
rationale: Owner directed immediate go-live (force-merged PR #1118); one issue, one PR under the fresh v7 approval per RUNBOOK §8.

description: Piping 'git merge' through tail in a shell chain (git merge origin/main 2>&1 | tail) makes the pipeline exit 0 even on CONFLICT, so the chain continues and can push nothing / delete an in-progress merge worktree. Happened on PR #1119 heal during pl-26f3.
resolution: Capture merge rc explicitly: run git merge redirected to a log file, test $?, and branch on MERGE_CONFLICT before integrity checks and push. Also cd out of a worktree before 'git worktree remove'.

description: Auto-merge races repair runs: a warren repair run dispatched onto a PR head branch delivers nothing useful if the PR auto-merges mid-run (branch deleted; reap push recreates an orphan branch). Happened twice in pl-26f3 (PRs #1104, #1106).
resolution: Cherry-pick the repair commit(s) from the orphaned branch onto a fresh branch off origin/main and open a new PR (#1106, #1108 pattern), or disarm auto-merge before dispatching a repair run onto a PR that could go green.

name: seeds-budget-double-conflict-heal
description: Dogfood pipeline heal recipe for seeds+budget double conflicts (pl-26f3 session): when a run PR conflicts on BOTH .seeds/issues.jsonl and scripts/bundle-size-budgets.json, merge origin/main taking main's budget file, then run 'bun run check:bundle-size --update' (builds first, measures the merged tree) and commit only the budget diff; seeds resolves via the driver. Used successfully on PRs #1125 and #1127.
